about_the_game:
★ Procurement Process － Supplier and Logistics

Purchasing goods from different suppliers, long-term cooperative suppliers will have more discounts, and as the industry reputation increases, there will also be other channels for cooperation. Choosing the appropriate logistics transportation, emergency air freight is also a good choice. The inventory system will be launched in the future.

★ Financial Management － Daily Expenses and Financing

Whether you want to build a business empire or a gaming paradise, income and expenses are essential considerations. Daily fixed expenses and losses, using low interest loans to create greater returns, maintaining reputation and enjoying VIP services from financial institutions, holding cash flow to cope with emergencies, avoiding blind expansion, and sudden fund chain breakage can also help short-term high interest emergency borrowing to overcome crises.

★ Build－Decorate and Expand

Attracting more attention from passersby with exquisite decoration, clear area layout affecting customers' stay time, different decoration styles increasing the consumption of corresponding customer groups, expanding areas, and even buying houses to improve long-term benefits. You can also create your own gaming house without pursuing business, and have an exclusive gaming world with a stable customer/friend group.

★ Environment - Time | Weather | Seaons | Festivals

Scarce goods become increasingly valuable over time, and goods with long-term inventory can be sold at a discount or for free, or a product may suddenly become valuable again over time. Prevent and maintain the aging of equipment and buildings, pay attention to the iteration and replacement of various game consoles, and use the double-edged sword of time well.Different weather and seasons will significantly affect the passenger flow. Generally, there will be more passenger flow on weekends and holidays. Most festivals will bring additional short-term benefits. Pay attention to extreme weather, such as rainstorm, wind, snow, and heat.

  • OS: Windows(64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
